tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for participating. First, could you tell me how often you listen to music in your daily life? Also, what are your favorite genres that you enjoy the most?
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢你的参与。首先，你能告诉我你在日常生活中听音乐有多频繁吗？另外，你最喜欢听的音乐类型是什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. Music is such a big part of life. If you had the opportunity to go to any show, which singer’s or band’s concert would you like to attend the most? Why do you choose them?
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。音乐是生活中很重要的一部分。如果你有机会去看一场演出，你最想去听哪位歌手或哪个乐队的演唱会？为什么选择他们？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting choice. Speaking of concerts, some people love the energy of a crowd, while others prefer listening at home. Do you prefer listening to recorded music or attending live music performances? Please state your reasons.
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思的选择。说到演唱会，有些人喜欢人群中的能量，而另一些人则更喜欢在家里听音乐。你更喜欢听录制的音乐，还是更喜欢去现场听音乐表演？请说明你的理由。
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. Lastly, let's talk about the role of artists. Some argue that musicians and artists are essential to society, while others think their roles are less important than those in practical fields like science or engineering. Do you agree or disagree with the statement that artists are vital to society? Use details to support your opinion.
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得好。最后，我们来谈谈艺术家的角色。有些人认为音乐家和艺术家对社会至关重要，而另一些人则认为他们的角色不如科学或工程等实用领域的人重要。你同意还是不同意“艺术家对社会至关重要”这一说法？请用细节来支持你的观点。
tasks.title: Interview
